note: Tells mode: a materials buyer with no visible tell, and the shop owns a scanner. Scan first: it is exact and keeps the shot.

client.name: Lower Level Citizen
lines: Need some scrap metal and a cell, if you have them.

options.label: Shoot: if an aug, about +128 cash, rep +2 LL/+2 BM/+2 Rev/+8 Sec, presence -25; if human, MANSLAUGHTER crime 500 and rep -15 LL/-15 Sec/-10 Rev/-10 BM (no game over); the sale is lost either way
Scan with the aug scanner (25 energy from its battery): an exact answer, and the gun stays available
Add 10% markup as a probe: an aug always refuses and stays; a human accepts 80%, refuses 8%, walks out 12% (-3 rep)
Threaten: an aug accepts (+20% deal) but can no longer be shot and escapes (presence +10); a human denies it: -7 rep, or 50% -10 rep and they leave
Serve them normally: an aug leaves alive (presence +10)
Send them away: an aug leaves alive (presence +10)
